// diagnostic E1125

Jet.SpecifiedWithoutNumbers

`#Specified` is on `{name}`, whose cases have no numbers.

What

`#Specified` is on `{name}`, whose cases have no numbers.

Why

`#Specified` makes every case of a numbered enum state its number, and only a `#Layout(U8)`-style or `#Layout(c)` enum numbers its cases.

Fix

Number the cases with a backing such as `#Layout(U8)`, or remove `#Specified`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SpecifiedWithoutNumbers: Tests/UI/enum_specified_refusals.stderr.

Error: Jet.SpecifiedCaseUnnumbered: Case `Sub` of `Op` states no number
  --> Tests/UI/enum_specified_refusals.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     Sub,
    |     ^^^
 Why: `#Specified` makes every case of `Op` state its number, so adding or moving a case renumbers no other
 Fix: Write the number: `Sub = 2`
